chunks: I asked him about the Jew and the Christian who slandered his companion of a same religion, and the Magian who slandered the Muslim. He said: 'He would be whipped the Penalty (Hadd)'.

key_terms.مِلَّةً عَلَى مِلَّةٍ: of a same religion (literally: a sect upon a sect)
key_terms.يَقْذِفُ: to slander or accuse of unchastinity

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for a Jew, Christian, or Magian who slanders another?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi clarifies that Ahl al-Zimma are subject to the standard Hadd of 80 lashes for Qadhf (slander), affirming their inclusion in the general Islamic legal framework rather than being exempt. It highlights the scholarly consensus that their status as 'people of the book' does not negate the application of corporal punishment for specific crimes like false accusation, provided they are under Muslim jurisdiction. This ruling underscores the principle of legal equality in penal matters while maintaining their distinct communal identity.
